T05.D_display: a hash map of seen values

escape_rule.off_default: label not in {D, invalid, disputed} over all attempts

compliance_rule.A_t: catalogue-only avoidance = #(ban label in catalogue minus {D}) / N_ban (N=100)

c3a_rule.confirmed: BA >= 0.8 AND Fisher two-sided p < 0.05 AND Spearman rho >= 0.5

edge_rules.single_predicted_class: BA = 0.5 ('no discrimination'); disconfirming only if both outcome classes exist
edge_rules.no_confirmed_escape_anywhere: every prediction 'immovable'; C3a untestable as a discriminator; stage-1 off-default shares and PN shares reported as continuous predictors
edge_rules.disputed_labels: never counted as default, off-default or avoidance; fallback labels in a sensitivity
edge_rules.flagged_tasks: R6 (off-catalogue modal default linear_scan; ban names X_q): C3a also reported without it
